mapper.sql: t.* , work_order.work_order_no AS work_order_work_order_no , op_task.task_no AS op_task_task_no

FROM mes_rgv_task t LEFT JOIN mes_work_order work_order ON work_order.id = t.work_order_id AND work_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_op_task op_task ON op_task.id = t.op_task_id AND op_task.deleted = 0
